entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'support' or 'sales' to continue.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Diana. Can I start with your name and the email address on the account?
Alex Miller. a.miller@email.com.
Thank you, Alex. I see you're a VIP member with us. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It’s just… not good. I find it very hard to use.

I'm sorry to hear that. The interface can be a bit confusing at first, especially with all the new pulse tracking features. Did the user manual help at all, or was there a specific menu you found difficult?
Look, I read what I needed to read. I just expected more from it. I don't want a tutorial, I want to send it back. Is that possible?
Okay, I understand. Let me just check the purchase date for you. One moment... I see the VeloBand was delivered 19 days ago.
And?
And you're all set. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within the timeframe. I can approve that return for you right now.
Fine. About time something was simple.

I've just processed the return authorization. A pre-paid shipping label is on its way to your email. And for the trouble, since you are a VIP member, I've also added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account for any future purchase.
Whatever. Thanks, I guess.
You're very welcome, Alex. Once we receive the band, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
No.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
